card.question: Which public boundary texts exist per gold domain, and could they revive the dead features (n_boundary_sources, has_done_support, imagined_only, latest_source)?
card.answer: They exist and mostly predate their gold (near-miss/fatality reports for Okoli; M&M, MAUDE, forums for Madani and Logishetty), but 0 of 108 URLs recorded by the three N2 runs N3 reads is a boundary host, and no public text is a DONE record, so has_done_support stays dead.
card.changed: Recommend the E-CTA primary test cover size, density, type and lens signal only; n_boundary_sources and imagined_only enter as secondary only if a gold-blind pre-freeze retrieval probe shows variance. Owner adopted this 2026-10-24.

worked: Boundary sources predating each primary gold found for all three; mappable to existing kinds with no new field.
failed: Host rules alone revive nothing: 0 of 50 cited sources and 0 of 108 recorded URLs are boundary hosts.
